description: This file defines the 'GuarantorType' enum used to categorize types of guarantors in the loan account domain, including methods for mapping integers to enum constants and checking guarantor categories.

classes.name: GuarantorType
classes.description: An enumeration representing different types of guarantors (Customer, Staff, External) with associated properties and utility methods.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the guarantor type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the guarantor type.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Retrieves the GuarantorType enum corresponding to the provided integer.

methods.name: getMinValue
methods.description: Returns the minimum integer value among guarantor types.

methods.name: getMaxValue
methods.description: Returns the maximum integer value among guarantor types.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the name of the guarantor type.

methods.name: isCustomer
methods.description: Checks if the guarantor type is CUSTOMER.

methods.name: isStaff
methods.description: Checks if the guarantor type is STAFF.
